items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs (finger) officially INACTIVE for Wednesday night vs Rams despite limited practices; expected return closer to Week 13. Backfield to MarShawn Lloyd/Kaleb Johnson/Chris Brooks committee.
items.why: Finger surgery recovery; LaFleur had downplayed availability all week.
items.implication: GB run game remains committee/inefficient; Lloyd or Johnson flex dart in tough matchup.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Lloyd/Johnson; reverse any prior Jacobs start plans.

items.text: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled OUT for Thursday Night vs Bills, his third straight missed game; short week cited for extra rest. Rookie Emmett Johnson expected to handle workhorse duties again after 100+ rush yards in prior starts.
items.why: Grade-two groin strain; team electing caution on short week after limited Tue practice.
items.implication: Emmett Johnson locks in as RB1/start with high volume/carries/receiving work vs BUF.
items.opportunity: Workhorse snaps/carries/red-zone for backup; Walker handcuff value delayed.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with ankle injury suffered Q2 vs Vikings (finished game, not high-ankle). Shanahan: day-to-day, 'always a possibility' he sits Sunday vs SEA; Mac Jones took 1st-team reps.
items.why: Ankle worsened post-game; spatted late vs MIN but no high sprain.
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri practice; if out, Mac Jones start tanks SF skill (CMC/Kittle/etc) ceiling vs SEA.
items.opportunity: If Purdy limited/out, reduced efficiency for pass-catchers; Jones streaming only in deep leagues.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving this week vs CAR: since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC have averaged more FPPG among RBs; elite matchup green light.
items.why: Elite recent PPG + soft CAR run defense.
items.implication: Must-start RB1/high-end RB2; smash spot for volume and efficiency.
items.opportunity: Snaps/carries/red-zone vs weak front; no usage conflict.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle (aggravated in Week 11). Prior notes indicated not 'too bad' but availability vs TEN Sunday now in question after multi-week issues.
items.why: Re-aggravation of ongoing foot/ankle; Coen previously downplayed Monday re-check.
items.implication: High risk for limited snaps or OUT; monitor for handcuff/backup surge if inactive.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE, clear path for committee backups (e.g. Rodriguez) in volume role.

items.text: Levitan on Travis Etienne: possible stretch where snaps and routes stay disappointing but carry count reasonably high. Cites Graziano; playoff schedule gets ARZ/ATL in Weeks 16/17 for solid floor.
items.why: Role split evolving; routes/snaps lag but rushing volume + schedule support floor.
items.implication: Hold as RB2/flex with rushing upside ROS; not pure three-down stud.
items.opportunity: Carry share/goal-line over routes/targets; playoff schedule upgrade.

items.text: Berry notes Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec/game) in two games with Brissett after <6% prior; significantly raises PPR floor. (Also Q concussion but expected to play.)
items.why: QB change unlocked receiving work; volume floor boost.
items.implication: Stronger PPR RB1/2 with dual-threat; LOVE floor vs prior pure-rusher profile.
items.opportunity: Targets + carries; monitor concussion protocol clearance.

items.text: Micah Parsons officially ACTIVE for Packers vs Rams (Zaire Franklin inactive). Return from ACL boosts GB pass rush.
items.why: Cleared for return; Packers inactives confirm.
items.implication: Defensive upgrade vs LAR; indirect pressure on Stafford/Rams skill.

items.text: Berry HATES Bo Nix this week (outside top 20): expects heavy Jonah Coleman usage vs PIT and insufficient Nix rushing production to compensate.
items.why: Run-game tilt + limited dual-threat upside in matchup.
items.implication: Sit/stream elsewhere; low ceiling as QB2.

items.text: Since Rico Dowdle return (Week 6), Jaylen Warren only 51% of PIT rush attempts, <10% target share in 3/5 games, RB20 utilization; now mid-to-low RB2 not fringe RB1.
items.why: Split backfield post-Dowdle return crushing volume.
items.implication: Fade as RB1; flex/RB2 only with Rudolph upside uncertain.

items.text: With Kyle Monangai back Week 11, D'Andre Swift dropped to 47% snaps / 39% rush attempts and <10% targets in 4/5 active Monangai games; mid-to-low RB2 not prior RB1.
items.opportunity: Snaps/carries/targets split; reverse prior absence boost.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share Week 11; season 36% avg and 50% of Eagles end-zone targets. Role elite despite injuries tanking overall production (Hurts absence noted).
items.implication: WR1 upside if volume holds; ride-or-die role confirmation.
items.opportunity: Target share / red-zone / routes elite; QB health key.

items.text: Ladd McConkey return: season-high 38% target share and 20.7 FP last week. When >=20% share this year averages 17.5 PPG; solid if he stays healthy (big IF).
items.why: Immediate high share on return; efficiency when involved.
items.implication: WR2/flex starter if healthy; monitor snap % stability.
items.opportunity: Target share expansion on return; routes when >50% snaps.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka last among 45 WRs with 50+ targets in YPT (5.0); no 50-yard game since Week 3; under 12 PPR in 17/20 recent games. Efficiency fade despite early hype.
items.why: Bottom-tier efficiency + volume not translating; QB/injury excuses partial.
items.implication: Sit/flex fade; not the early-season breakout anymore.
items.opportunity: Poor YPRR/YPT despite targets; reverse stale breakout.
